      "feature_family": "permission_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Focused telephony risk score provides a strong linear signal for SVM to detect SMS-based malware and call fraud applications.",

      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product-like interaction between storage access and network permissions. Apps that both read/write storage and have network access can exfiltrate data.",

      "feature_family": "permission_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures dangerous permission combinations that individually may be benign but together indicate data exfiltration capability, useful for SVM non-linear approximation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(`android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`.astype(float) + `android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`.astype(float)) * `android.permission.INTERNET`.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "system_control_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Score for permissions that allow system-level control: killing processes, changing network state, mounting filesystems, and modifying system settings.",
      "value_range": [0, 6],
      "feature_family": "permission_risk",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,
